svg.title: PilotSwarm upstream contribution dependency DAG, vertical layout
svg.desc: 69 numbered candidate contribution nodes and 92 dependency edges arranged from top to bottom by dependency depth, colored green for low risk, amber for medium risk, and red for high risk. A blue outer ring marks an open upstream pull request.
svg.text: Dependency depth flows from top to bottom. Select a node to open its candidate plan entry.
